ambient_trade.text: salt in {town} at {gold} gold a sack, fair weights, no tricks. anyone buying in bulk?
selling dyed wool out of {town}, {gold} gold the bolt. serious buyers only, i'm not chasing you.
looking to buy 40 sacks of grain near {town}, paying {gold} gold. the caravan is waiting.
wool in {town} has dropped to {gold} gold, which is a crime. holding my stock till it climbs back.
anyone need horses hauled to {town}? i'll take {gold} gold and deliver on time, every time.

encounter_trade_offer.text: {player}, i know you hate me, but a wagon of salt for {gold} gold beats a burned cart. think on it.
no hard feelings yet. {gold} gold for safe passage through {town}, and you keep your teeth. fair deal.
ser {player}, offer stands: {gold} gold for an escort into {town}. fair coin, no tolls on top.
could do {gold} gold for the road to {town}. not a bad rate for either of us, is it?
ah, {player}, for you it's {gold} gold and i'll throw in a bolt of wool. don't tell the others.

encounter_greeting.text: {player}, {persona} of {my_faction} here. your men are blocking my road and that's bad for both of us.
{player}, you're in my way and my wagons are heavy. move aside, or let's talk about what it costs.
ser {player}, {persona} of {my_faction}. road's clear, my wagons are heavy, let's keep this friendly.
{player}! {persona} here, {my_faction} salt and wool. still got good wine for trade, or have you drunk it all?

player_raided_my_village.text: {player} burned {village}? that's a cart of wool gone and a season of trade lost. stop it, please.
{player}, you burned {village}. i can forgive a lot, but not a torched granary. talk to me.
burning {village} gets you nothing but a bad name on the roads, {player}. no one trades with arsonists.
{player}, {village} was a fair trade town. name your price for making it right and we'll see.

war_declared.text: {my_faction} has declared war on {enemy_faction}. every cart on those roads is now a target, great.
war with {enemy_faction} is official. my wool prices just went up, and not in my favor.
{my_faction} and {enemy_faction} at war again. the only winners here are the bandits.
sharpen your swords if you like, but my caravans will be taking the long road around {enemy_faction}.

peace_made.text: peace between {my_faction} and {faction} at last. the roads can breathe, and so can my ledger.
{my_faction} has made peace with {faction}. time to restock, the markets are finally sane again.
good news, the {my_faction} and {faction} treaty is signed. expect cheaper salt by the week's end.
with {faction} at peace, my wagons can finally use the old road. anyone want a ride to market?

released_by_player.text: {player} let me go without ransom? you've got my respect and a discount on wool for life.
thanks for letting me walk, {player}. a ransom is a fair number too, if you ever want one.
you released me, {player}, which is cheaper than my usual rate. i'll remember it.
{player} freed me for nothing. either you're soft or you're plotting something. either way, noted.

beat_by_player.text: {player} beat my {troop_count} men at the ford. that battle cost me more than the road ever paid.
{player}, {troop_count} of my lads lost on the field. i'd rather we talk price than swords.
{player}, {troop_count} men gone and my wagons with them. well fought, but i still want my due.
a loss of {troop_count} troops, {player}. damn it. still, my coin is sound if you want a deal.

whisper_beg_help.text: {player}, {enemy_faction} is at {fief}'s gates and my caravans are stuck. send help and i'll pay you well.
{player}, you're the only one i trust. {fief} is burning and {enemy_faction} won't stop. name your price.
ser {player}, {fief} won't hold against {enemy_faction} much longer. name a price and i'll meet it.
{player}, my friend, {fief} needs an escort or it's lost. the gold's in my strongbox, i swear on the wool.

ambient_complaint.text: {rival} is charging double for salt in {town}. that's not a market, that's robbery.
bandits on the {town} road again. my wagons are not free to replace, people.
{faction} tolls keep climbing and nobody's stopping it. my margins are bleeding out at the gates.
{rival} undercuts everyone and then cries when no one buys. no sympathy from this caravan.
every lord keeps starting wars over nothing. the {faction} lords especially. sort it out, please.

ambient_chatter.text: rain on the {town} road again. my wool's going soggy and my patience with it.
lag in {town} is wrecking my caravan timing. who's running the host, and can they fix it?
heard {village} has a new mill. might be worth a visit for the flour trade, if the prices hold.
the map says the {town} pass is clear. i'll believe it when my wagon gets through in one piece.
anyone else stuck at {village} for an hour? lost half a day and a wheel, fine way to start a week.
